source.author: verg
source.text: Cui parvus Iulus, cui pater et coniunx quondam tua dicta relinquor?
source.text_original: Cui parvus Iulus, / cui pater et coniunx quondam tua dicta relinquor?'
source.text_english: To whom am I left, little Iulus, to whom, my father and my husband once so named?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: cui nos seruituros relinquis? nunc et gerula quondam, iam anus, et nutricius, secundus post naturalem pietatis pater, clamitat:
reuse.text_original: 'cui nos seruituros relinquis?' nunc et gerula quondam, iam anus, et nutricius, secundus post naturalem pietatis pater, clamitat:
reuse.text_english: To whom do you leave us to be slaves? Now too the nurse who once carried you, now an old woman, and the foster-father, second after the natural father in affection, cries out:
